card.name: Lower bound of confidence interval decimals
card.fires_on: The first digit after the decimal point in the lower limit of a 95% confidence interval, such as the 3 in 1.3. It appears in risk or odds ratio results.

modes.label: Lower CI limit digit
modes.description: A single digit after the decimal point of the lower bound in a bracketed confidence interval following a risk estimate.

card.plain: It fires on the decimal digit of the lower limit in a confidence interval for a risk ratio.
